errors.message: Even if the exact union matches, old LINE IDs/bodies were not preserved. Original diff is retained.

limitations: Geometry preservation is not a new DRC/CAM or model-fit approval.
3D mesh correctness, body height, polarity and final visual fit remain separate checks.
If LINE records are reserialized, strict old record equality is FALSE even when exact physical centerline union preservation is proved.
